labels:
Standard

Displays one large photo at a time.

Centered Preview

Shows the main photo centered with partial previews of the next and previous images.

Show thumbnails under photo carousel

When enabled, thumbnail images will display below the main photo carousel for easy navigation. When disabled, website visitors can scroll through photos individually.

Show virtual tour player

When enabled, listings with a virtual tour link will display an embedded player directly on the property details page. When disabled, the embedded player will not display.
Display below listing data and description

Display lead capture sidebar alongside listing details

When enabled, a lead capture sidebar will display alongside your listing details content. We recommend disabling this if you already have a sidebar built into your page outside of the listing details content.

Make lead capture actions sticky

When enabled, lead capture options will be fixed to the top of the browser window as visitors scroll. When disabled, lead capture options will scroll with the rest of the page content.
